purpose: Text-free impasto backgrounds and transparent decorative still-life objects for tactile UI cards. Typography, data and controls are rendered separately in HTML.
promptPractice: Backgrounds: landscape, evenly distributed low-contrast palette-knife texture, no subject, no text, no logos, no watermark. Objects: one isolated subject, hand-painted gouache and palette-knife texture, transparent background, no writing or branding.
alphaValidation: All decorative objects have four channels, fully transparent and nearly or fully opaque source pixels, and transparent pixels retained in optimized WebP output. For the seven new categories, low-alpha backdrop haze below 96 was removed before trimming; five revised sources were selected after visual inspection.
